scope: Retrospective bounded G1/physical-antenna-2 audit and equal-packet MUSIC sensitivity on the newest matched A-E records. No raw file, old analysis, thesis or Overleaf changes. No new physical calibration is claimed.
inputs: Frozen selected caches, packet ledgers, source hashes, representatives and complex covariances from ../coherent_array_validation_20261106/. Verify the raw selected packets against the cache, state logs and permutation parser.
budget: Identical to the preceding coherent comparison: 864 unique raw packets per run per arm; 24 six-state cycles with 6 packets per state, versus 864 G2-only packets over the same 10 s. R1 first 8 cycles/batches establish reference and weights; R1 remaining 16 and all R3 remain diagnostic checks. R2 first 12 predict, last 12 and half bands check. No resampling to make results better.
audit: Compare all six states and all three chains using raw digital power, zero and rail counts, tone profiles and within-visit conjugate pair phase. Fit phase reference on alternating packets and check the unused packets. Check G1 using only chains 1 and 3 and 20 tones for common phase/slope; chain 2 and other tones are predictions, not independently corrected. Classify evidence, not hardware causality: antenna 2 never switches to another chain or branch in these data.
weight: For each site, use only G1/R1 first 8 cycles. For each simultaneous chain pair, form unit conjugate products; reference is the circular mean of packets 0,2,4 and evaluate packets 1,3,5. V_ij is the mean 1-cos(held phase error), excluding zero products with coverage reported. w2=clip(V13 / ((V12+V23)/2 + 1e-15),0.05,1). This is an empirical phase-reliability weight, NOT measured SNR or inverse receiver noise variance. All other physical antennas retain squared residual weight 1. Freeze the weight before any R2 estimates are scored.
weighted_scan: Keep the original background and foreground eigensubspaces and their noise-floor/tone eligibility tests. With h=leading R1 vector, u=leading eigenvector of B R2 B, B=I-hh^H, D=diag(sqrt(w)), compute weighted orthogonal residual ratio ||P_perp(D[h,u]) D a(theta)||^2 / ||P_perp(Dh) D a(theta)||^2. Both subspace and manifold are transformed, not just CSI. w=1 must reproduce the old projected MUSIC exactly. This is weighted subspace fitting of MUSIC subspaces, not a claim of optimal noise whitening. We do not re-eigendecompose D R D as if its noise were white.
weighted_fit: Only in G1, fit one common packet phase and frequency slope using objective sum_m,k w_m conj(x_mk) ref_mk exp(-j2pi f_k tau). Apply the SAME correction to all three chains. Keep first-packet reference and the six selected packets. Other states, shared-antenna tree and calibration hypothesis stay unchanged. Soft-mask correlation is recomputed with sqrt(weights), never using the binary-mask normalization from the earlier helper.
eleven: Dropping antenna 2 removes its row/column and steering coordinate, rebuilds the 11-element eigensubspaces, and is explicitly an 11-element diagnostic. Raw acquisition budget stays 864. It must not be labelled a 12-element success.
release: Physical human AoA remains unverified without independent fixed-response calibration and human-path attribution. A consistent wrong peak is not success. Keep all failures and no-output outcomes. Report all predefined methods across all sites, never choose one method per truth point. These repeatedly viewed records are development data, not an unseen test.
scoring: Write and hash weights, predictions, spectra and prediction code before a separate scorer reads the five human coordinates. Use one common RX-centre angle for both arms. Whole-R2 peaks are descriptive and cannot replace the first-half/held-half experiment. Compare changes against BOTH original 12 and G2. Report provisional MAE, median, maximum, numerical coverage, spectral and physical acceptance separately.
